topics.purpose: Define a read-only/candidate-edit Expose graph for relation types, relation instances, containment, composition closure and reference integrity.

semantics.readonly_rule: Default is read-only; graph edits create candidate relation changes.
semantics.identity_rule: Relation type, relation instance, endpoint, containment and composition identities remain distinct.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing/drawing candidate edge grants no endpoint authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Only explicit accepted edges are semantic.
semantics.action_rule: add/remove/retype/apply relation operations use separate authorized workflows.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.
